cgroup2_root_controllers: cpuset cpu io memory hugetlb pids rdma misc dmem
command: import pathlib,json,threading; rel=pathlib.Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text().strip().split("::",1)[1]; cg=pathlib.Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")/rel.lstrip("/"); print(json.dumps({k:(cg/k).read_text().strip() for k in ("cpu.max","memory.max","memory.swap.max","pids.max")}),flush=True); threading.Event().wait(0.15)
